title: Old quotes: the reference product keeps the number with a clock, ours labels it stale or refuses it (G-11-4)
reference_behaviour: A quote is never labelled stale; the builder keeps computing with the last price it has and shows only the time prices were last updated.
ours: Quotes carry a health state; stale and delayed are labelled, unhealthy and unavailable are refused (REQ-049 AC-2, AC-4). Kept: stricter safety, ADR-152 exception (a), decided by ADR-015.
